title: Iran member report to the 2025 WAHO conference
observation: The 2025 Arabian registry report states approximately 1,000-1,200 registered foals per year. This is breed-specific annual registration flow, not all horses, all breeders, platform customers, or total addressable revenue.
evidence_quality: Primary registry report; indexed text available; direct open intermittently failed.

title: Sheyhe published product
observation: Advertises bilingual horse and pedigree information, offspring and results, horse listings and equipment. Product overlap is substantial; its user count, transaction volume and revenue were not verified.

title: Chaharnal published product
observation: Publishes horse and equipment listings, riding-club discovery and educational content. Advertised prices and listings do not prove completed sales or willingness to pay for this platform.

title: Iran Horse published service offering
observation: A local offering spanning equipment and horse-related services; review as a potential distribution/merchant partner as well as a competitor. No revenue or conversion claims verified.
evidence_quality: Primary business page; capability observation only.

title: HorseTelex subscriptions
observation: Published PLUS and TOP plans illustrate a free-core/paid-professional product pattern. Observed annual prices: EUR22.50 and EUR75 including VAT. Foreign prices are not an Iranian willingness-to-pay benchmark.

title: ehorses premium subscriptions
observation: Published seller subscriptions demonstrate paid exposure tools. Observed Premium EUR59.98 and Premium Plus EUR99.99 per month; geography, plan terms and volumes differ from Iran.
evidence_quality: Primary competitor pricing page; not an Iranian price estimate.

title: Zarinpal tariff
observation: Published standard gateway charge: 0.5%, capped at 16,000 toman, plus 500 toman per transaction. Shaparak charges are additional; the calculator does not estimate them.
evidence_quality: Primary supplier page, observed 2026-10-03; confirm merchant contract before billing.

title: Liara tariff
observation: Example IaaS: 2 GB memory, 1 vCPU, 20 GB disk at 1,475,000 toman/month; IPv4 and traffic extra. Cost reference only, not Worker compatibility certification.

title: Kavenegar tariff
observation: Standard account free; published paid annual account tiers are separate from usage. Obtain route-specific OTP/notification unit prices and delivery terms rather than assuming a universal SMS fee.
evidence_quality: Primary supplier page; no verified per-message price used.

title: Zarinpal server verification documentation
observation: Payment completion requires server-side verification; use a trusted stored amount and unique authority. An already-verified response must not create duplicate entitlement.
evidence_quality: Primary integration documentation; live integration not executed.

title: UC Davis VGL PSSM1
observation: PSSM1 is autosomal dominant. Presence of a risk-associated genotype is not a complete clinical assessment.

title: UC Davis VGL MH
observation: Equine malignant hyperthermia is autosomal dominant. Do not display a one-copy result as a recessive unaffected carrier.

title: UC Davis VGL HYPP
observation: HYPP is dominant; distinct one-copy and two-copy results remain distinct even when grouped in the same risk-status bucket.

title: UC Davis VGL agouti
observation: Agouti assay references ASIP; legacy ASLIP label is not a valid replacement gene symbol.

title: UC Davis VGL dun
observation: Dun locus annotation references TBX3. Legacy TMEM38 labeling needs report review, not an automatic scientific conclusion.

title: UC Davis VGL cream
observation: Cream and champagne must not be conflated; cream references SLC45A2.

title: UC Davis VGL champagne
observation: Champagne references SLC36A1. A legacy cream_SLC36A1 row is ambiguous without its original report.

title: UC Davis CEH PSSM overview
observation: Do not equate unsupported PSSM2 commercial genetic claims with the validated PSSM1 assay. Unknown assays stay uninterpreted.

title: ECAHO commissions and groups
observation: In ECAHO show context DC means Disciplinary Committee. Model separately from course designer, judge, steward and ringmaster.

title: FEI official lists
observation: Credentials are role-, discipline-, issuer- and time-specific. A directory profile is not proof of an appointment or license.

title: FEI website terms
observation: Public web access is not unrestricted permission for commercial copying. Obtain appropriate permission or licensed access before ingesting competitor/authority databases.
evidence_quality: Primary terms; legal review still required for the actual arrangement.

title: WCAG 2.2 target size minimum
observation: WCAG 2.2 AA target-size criterion uses 24 CSS pixels with specified exceptions; project touch-control target is deliberately 44 pixels. Compact does not mean inaccessible.
